blocks.text: Banda’s own attendant spirits and hidden aids now fail him, and the text emphasizes that any effort to strike the Guru rebounds destructively upon the servants of occult pride.
Having seen the Guru and the Singhs’ force, Banda’s certainty breaks. He recognizes a fullness he cannot match and submits at the Guru’s feet in visible defeat.
The page marks the collapse of sorcery before sanctity: Banda’s “barkat” is shown to be empty beside the Guru’s power, and submission replaces mockery.
